detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

SLU-PP-332

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C18H14N2O2
  • Compound Class: Synthetic small-molecule research compound
  • Chemical Type: Non-peptide heterocyclic compound
  • Molecular Weight: ~290 g/mol (approximate; refer to CoA for exact value)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

SLU-PP-332 is a synthetic small-molecule compound developed for use in controlled laboratory research environments. Unlike peptide-based materials, SLU-PP-332 is produced through chemical synthesis and is intended for analytical and mechanistic investigation in non-clinical research settings.

Supplied as a solid research material, SLU-PP-332 is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of small-molecule behavior in biochemical assay systems
  • Laboratory studies focused on structure–activity relationships of synthetic compounds
  • Analytical method development involving non-peptide research materials
  • Comparative analysis of small-molecule analogs under controlled experimental conditions
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from light
  • Keep container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety procedures and personal protective equipment
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in common laboratory solvents
Compliance Notice:

SLU-PP-332 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
